title: 16-Mode Ring Continuous Joint BiGAN
intuition: Trains a joint BiGAN (G(z), E(x), D(x, z)) on a 16-mode Gaussian ring with MoGParticlePrior(sigma=0.1), requiring both 16/16 generative mode recovery and high encoder-decoder mode consistency (>= 0.98) and reconstruction accuracy.
failure_mode: Joint critic D(x, z) fails to couple encoder and generator distributions, leading to accurate marginal samples but scrambled reconstructions (recon_rmse > 0.12 or mode_consistency < 0.98).
